problem_text:
A city planner needs to distribute a fixed budget across 18 community development projects to maximize the overall social benefit score.  
The profile for each project is as follows:  
* Project A: benefit score 0.154, impact factor 0.160, allocation limits [0.084, 0.892]  
* Project B: benefit score 0.163, impact factor 0.180, allocation limits [0.003, 0.511]  
* Project C: benefit score 0.053, impact factor 0.217, allocation limits [0.097, 0.623]  
* Project D: benefit score 0.107, impact factor 0.239, allocation limits [0.050, 0.426]  
* Project E: benefit score 0.136, impact factor 0.046, allocation limits [0.036, 0.359]  
* Project F: benefit score 0.098, impact factor 0.228, allocation limits [0.054, 0.792]  
* Project G: benefit score 0.123, impact factor 0.290, allocation limits [0.042, 0.442]  
* Project H: benefit score 0.038, impact factor 0.270, allocation limits [0.094, 0.413]  
* Project I: benefit score 0.031, impact factor 0.062, allocation limits [0.000, 0.480]  
* Project J: benefit score 0.184, impact factor 0.184, allocation limits [0.030, 0.800]  
* Project K: benefit score 0.163, impact factor 0.062, allocation limits [0.094, 0.874]  
* Project L: benefit score 0.053, impact factor 0.171, allocation limits [0.051, 0.661]  
* Project M: benefit score 0.166, impact factor 0.242, allocation limits [0.078, 0.430]  
* Project N: benefit score 0.024, impact factor 0.046, allocation limits [0.065, 0.515]  
* Project O: benefit score 0.120, impact factor 0.047, allocation limits [0.044, 0.377]  
* Project P: benefit score 0.117, impact factor 0.070, allocation limits [0.057, 0.673]  
* Project Q: benefit score 0.166, impact factor 0.057, allocation limits [0.069, 0.345]  
* Project R: benefit score 0.108, impact factor 0.173, allocation limits [0.052, 0.453]  

Each project must receive a budget share within its specified limits, and the total allocation across all projects must equal the entire budget. To ensure timely completion, the subset of high-priority projects L = {B, C, D, E, F, G, I, K, L, M, O, P, R} must together receive at least 0.658 of the total budget. Additionally, the overall impact factor of the portfolio must not exceed 0.211, and the total benefit score must be at least 0.090. Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total benefit score while satisfying all constraints.
